Satoyama Treasure Hunter!! – Make a Wreath from Nature's Materials

Hanno Eco-Tourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/hanno-eco/tour/ec-morimana-treasurehunter/

An interactive eco-tour where you enjoy treasure hunting in nature while learning about ecosystems and the charm of satoyama (traditional rural landscape) alongside specialist students.

【Fee】
Adults: ¥2,500
Students: ¥1,500
Preschool children: ¥1,000
(Includes guide, insurance, materials, food, etc.)

【Capacity】20 people

【Guide】Mori no Field Gakusha staff

【What to bring】Gloves, drinks, lunch, change of clothes, insect repellent if needed

【More information】Mori no Field Gakusha website: https://morinomanabiya168.wixsite.com/website
